what_it_proves: Target's base retail model was under pressure in the fiscal year.
boundary: A sales decline does not isolate traffic, ticket, category mix, or customer income pressure by itself.

what_it_proves: Target remained a large household-spending platform despite pressure.
boundary: Large sales do not prove durable loyalty, margin quality, or consumer health.

what_it_proves: The pressure reached operating profit, not only headline sales.
boundary: Operating income decline does not identify whether price, mix, shrink, wages, markdowns, or fulfillment costs drove the weakness.

what_it_proves: The business remained profitable while weakened.
boundary: Operating income is not cash flow and does not prove channel-level cash quality.

what_it_proves: The second relationship layer grew faster than the pressured core basket.
boundary: Non-merchandise growth does not prove that the main merchandise trip has recovered.

what_it_proves: Membership economics were scaling from a small or newer base.
boundary: Growth does not prove renewal quality, cohort durability, or pricing power.

what_it_proves: Target+ marketplace was becoming a larger assortment extension.
boundary: Marketplace growth does not prove seller economics, customer trust, or contribution margin.

what_it_proves: Convenience demand was visible even while the core store relationship was uneven.
boundary: Delivery growth does not prove delivery margin, fulfillment cost recovery, or return economics.

what_it_proves: The company showed current-quarter sales recovery after fiscal-year weakness.
boundary: One quarter of sales recovery does not prove a durable turnaround.

what_it_proves: Existing stores and channels improved in the quarter.
boundary: Comparable sales do not separate traffic from ticket or volume from price/mix.

what_it_proves: Digital demand supported the relationship-repair thesis.
boundary: Digital comps do not prove eCommerce cash quality without fulfillment cost, returns, and margin.

what_it_proves: The store, digital, and convenience rebuild required real investment.
boundary: Capex growth is not automatically good unless it improves traffic, basket, margin, inventory turn, or cash conversion.
